source: Observed public20260409 idle/holding/attack-moving/acquisition rules and original unit initialization, independently implemented

implemented.automatic_acquisition_gate: stable allocated soldier slot modulo6 equals simulation step modulo6
implemented.hold_scan_gate: interval and cooldown, no six-slot gate
implemented.idle_melee: acquire -> next step pursue -> in-range transition -> next step attack
implemented.player_ranged: acquire in range -> attack phase -> next step windup
implemented.target_death: clear target and consume transition step; attack-move retains route and primes next scan
implemented.attacking: does not retarget before attack-leash exit

local_choices_or_gaps: Random stream uses battle-owned fixed seed20260409 for reproducible runs; original uses global RNG and cannot have matching random sequence established.
Six-way phase follows simulation steps so pause/half-speed and30/60/120-render runs remain reproducible; original uses Engine physics frame phase, including nonbattle engine activity.
Allocated scan slots are stable and increasing; original dead-slot reuse is not yet implemented.
Retarget0.15 timer is still represented as next_scan deadline rather than full original per-state remaining timer.
Autonomous battlefield director, local paths and extended mechanics remain local; original strategic role AI and full43unit/ability set are incomplete.
No original controlled auto-acquisition timing capture this turn; functional tests verify independent implementation, not complete original equivalence.
